## Features

* In-game transformations, As a exalted custom skin you can change her hat using ctrl + 1, her hair using ctrl + 2, her top with ctrl + 3, her skirt with ctrl + 4, the shoes and stockings using ctrl + 5 and finally her weapon using the recall. There are 15.626 possible combinations so have fun!

*The toggle system works like a gacha with probability so sometimes you have to press several times until you get the desired garment
* New model and textures
* Supports all champion texture quality settings
* New VFX and SFX
* New Homeguard VFX for each weapon
* New animations
* Modified LoadScreen
